description: November 30 birthday meaning: Sagittarius decan 1, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a November 30 birthday falls in Sagittarius, in the first decan, with Jupiter as the sign's ruler and Jupiter as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Sagittarius is mutable and fire.

sections.heading: The November 30 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Closing November, the 30th puts the Sun near eight degrees of Sagittarius, still in the Jupiter decan, and reduces to 3, the number of expression. Jupiter magnifies everything, so this tends to read as a big voice: an entertaining talker, satirist or teacher who combines frankness with humour and is rarely short of an opinion.

Astronomically, November 30 puts the Sun near 8° Sagittarius in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Jupiter. Jupiter rules Sagittarius and presides over its first decan as well, from about November 23 to December 1. This is traditionally the most expansive, optimistic stretch of the sign. Natives are often described as adventurous, generous and philosophical, eager to travel, learn and share whatever they have discovered. Humour and candour come easily, and so can a tendency to say the true thing a little too bluntly. Doubled Jupiter can make commitments multiply faster than time allows. These Archers tend to thrive when their search for meaning has room to roam but also somewhere to come home to.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for November 30
paragraphs: A birthday on the 30th reduces as 3 + 0 = 3. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 3, so this birthday number carries an extra dose of expression, imagination and social energy. Unlike the 12th or 21st, the compound contains only the 3 itself, which numerologists sometimes describe as creativity without dilution. Thirtieth-born people are frequently described as eloquent, entertaining and quick with ideas. As a secondary number, the 30 tends to shine in writing, speaking or performance. Focus is their usual challenge, since so many ideas compete for attention.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a November 30 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous November 30 birthdays
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 30 is the 334th day of the year (335th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Capricorn, is usually complete within 22 days, by December 22.

By November 30 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a November 30 birthday are Winston Churchill (1874), Mark Twain (1835) and Theodor Mommsen (1817).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 30?
faq.answer: November 30 is Sagittarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Sagittarius, which tradition links with Jupiter.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 30?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 30 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 22 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 30th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 30?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by November 30, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 30?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on November 30 include Winston Churchill (1874), Mark Twain (1835) and Theodor Mommsen (1817). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
